'''Silver's Ursaring''' (Japanese: '''シルバーのリングマ''' ''Silver's Ringuma'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Silver}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his seventh overall. In the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}, he was given to {{adv|Giovanni}}. As of ''[[PS180|The Last Battle XIV]]'', he is at level 44.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
[[File:Silver and Ursaring.png|thumb|left|200px|Ursaring and Silver]]
Ursaring first appeared in ''[[PS101|Teddiursa's Picnic]]'', attacking {{adv|Gold}} and [[Maizie]] as they approached a wild {{p|Teddiursa}}. Ursaring chases the two and they soon run into {{adv|Silver}}. Realizing that Silver is planning on capturing Ursaring, Gold decides to catch him as well. Gold sends [[Aibo]] out to attack Ursaring and he starts unleashing multiple {{m|Scratch}}es on him. Silver quickly joins in and tells {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}} and {{TP|Silver|Croconaw}} to attack Ursaring as well, irritating the Hibernator Pokémon. Ursaring then aims a {{m|Slash}} at [[Maizie]] and Gold saves her just in time. Ursaring attempts another Slash and {{p|Sneasel}} jumps in and uses {{m|Icy Wind}} to freeze his paws, though he manages to thaw them with {{m|Fire Punch}}. Ursaring and Teddiursa soon corner the group on a cliff. While the situation looked hopeless, Silver taught Gold the proper way to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a Pokémon, and the two managed to catch Ursaring and Teddiursa. Afterwards, Silver uses Ursaring to defeat the {{tc|Team Rocket Grunts}} disturbing the {{p|Slowpoke}} at [[Slowpoke Well]].

In ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', Ursaring participated in Silver's fight against Gold, going up against his [[Sudobo]]. Ursaring attacked with a barrage of {{m|Fury Swipes}}, while Sudobo countered it with {{m|Mimic}}. After a quick show of strength, with Ursaring coming out on top, he is recalled in favor of {{p|Kingdra}}.

In ''[[PS145|Sandslash Surprise]]'', Ursaring and the rest of Silver's team helped defeat a group of {{p|Sandslash}}.

In ''[[PS177|The Last Battle XI]]'', Ursaring and Silver's other Pokémon defeated [[Will]] by attacking with Sneasel's {{m|Beat Up}}.
[[File:Silver Ursaring helping Giovanni.png|thumb|left|250px|Ursaring tasked with protecting Giovanni]]
==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
[[File:Giovanni and Ursaring.png|thumb|right|175px|Ursaring and Giovanni]]
In ''[[PS301|Storming the Forretress]]'', Silver gave Ursaring to his father, {{adv|Giovanni}}, so Ursaring could take him to one of Silver's secret hideouts to recover.

==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===
Sometime before the start of the arc, Giovanni and Ursaring were in [[Ilex Forest]] waiting for {{adv|Celebi}} to appear. Celebi eventually came and brought [[Pryce]] along with it, whom Ursaring immediately began attacking. Before he could cause any major damage, though, [[Lance]] showed up and stopped them, informing the group that they all shared a common goal.

In ''[[PS456|All About Arceus V]]'', Ursaring shows up alongside Giovanni to help with the {{adv|Arceus}} crisis. Upon arriving, he ruthlessly brushed [[Petrel]] aside after he attempts to disguise himself as Giovanni. Soon after, he battled {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina}} and attacks with a powerful Slash. Later, during the battle, Ursaring threw his opponent around and used {{m|Avalanche}}, dealing heavy damage.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
Typical of his [[Pokémon (species)|species]], Ursaring seems to be aggressive and hostile toward everyone. Ursaring was also an extremely powerful battler, being the powerhouse of {{adv|Silver}}'s team when he was with him, and he was even recognized by {{adv|Giovanni}} for his strength. Ursaring has a lot of pride, as he refused to be captured by an average {{pkmn|Trainer}}.

==Trivia==
* Ursaring is currently Silver's only Pokémon to be kept inside a [[Poké Ball]] variant.
* Ursaring is the only Pokémon belonging to Silver that has not reached his final form.
* Ursaring is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Avalanche}}.
